ml.description:

सागर में नैया डाल दई ॥

भक्ति की पतवार,
ओ रामा, ज्ञान की लगा दी जंजीर,
सागर में नैया डार दई ।

रामा, कौन लगाहे बेड़ा पार?
सागर में नैया डार दई ।
मैंने तेरे ही भरोसे हनुमान,
सागर में नैया डाल दई ॥
सीता मैया बैठनहारी,
लक्ष्मण खेवनहार,

चरणन में बलिहार,
मोरे बालाजी लगाहे बेड़ा पार,
सागर में नैया डार दई ।
मैंने तेरे ही भरोसे हनुमान,
सागर में नैया डाल दई ॥

ప్రేమ, జ్ఞాపకాలు, అనుబంధాలు, జీవితంలో మనల్ని మార్చే కొన్ని ప్రత్యేకమైన క్షణాల కథే **‘సహా – లైఫ్ ఆఫ్ సంజు’**. సంజు జీవితంలో చోటుచేసుకున్న ప్రేమ, విడిపోవడం, గత జ్ఞాపకాలు అతని జీవితాన్ని ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేశాయనే ఆసక్తికరమైన కథాంశంతో ఈ చిత్రం తెరకెక్కుతోంది.

నిశాంత్ దోటి దర్శకత్వంలో రూపొందుతున్న ఈ సినిమాలో శివ కుమార్ కాసారం, శ్వేతా లక్ష్మణ్ ప్రధాన పాత్రల్లో నటిస్తున్నారు. శేఖర్ చంద్ర సంగీతం అందిస్తున్నారు.

The end of an era begins.

A new threat is rising. The Avengers are assembling once again. And at the center of it all stands Doctor Doom.

Lyrics : Gujarati 

હે મારે બનાહકાંઠા માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે  
અલ્યા લાખાણી માંશે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે
વાવ થરાદ માંશે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હો રમશુ રે કાનુડો અમે રમશુ રે કાનુડો
સૈયરો સંગાથે અમે રમશુ રે કાનુડો 
કે પસી દિયોદર માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે
ભાભર મેવાહ માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે લુણપુર શદરપુર માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
નેહડા મુડેઠા માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે અરે રે અરે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે જીરે...

હે બનાહ મારુ મન જોજીલુ વાલો એનો નેહડો 
મારા રે મલક નો વખણાય કોનુંડો 
હે અરે રે અરે બનાહ મારુ મન જોજીલુ વાલો એનો વગડો 
મારા રે મલક નો વખણાય કોનુંડો 
હો કોનૂડા ટોણા આયા કોનૂડા ટોણા 
ગાશે સૈયર ગોણા ગાશે સૈયર ગોણા   
હે ખીમોણા માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
મારા શિહોરી માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે મારા થરા ગામે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
હે ભિલડી ગામે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે ડીસા પાલનપુર માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
હે ધાનેરા માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે મારે નાયતા ગામે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
કોઇટા માણેકપુર ગામે ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે 
હે મારા આસેડા માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
હે લાખણાસર માં ઢોલ ના ઢીસાકા રે 
રે હમણાં કોનુંડો પાસો વાળશે હો જીરે
હે અરે અરે રે આવતા કોનુંડે પાસા મળશું હો જીરે...

snippet.title: GTA VI Extended Look | 13 Years Later - GTA Is BACK!
snippet.description:
AuraGold App Download Link: https://onelink.to/a2dauragoldapp

In this video, PC Doc explores the groundbreaking details hidden within the highly anticipated GTA VI trailer and the massive technological leap it represents for the gaming industry. From the fascinating evolution of in-game physics compared to past titles like GTA V and San Andreas to the mind-blowing attention to detail like dynamic hair, moving jewelry, and realistic vehicle mechanics he examines how Rockstar Games is setting a new standard for open-world environments. By breaking down the revamped police wanted system, the unprecedented NPC density, and the introduction of a dynamic relationship mechanic between the protagonists, the video reveals how the game is shifting towards unparalleled realism. Ultimately, the discussion provides a transparent look into the intense hardware demands and framerate expectations of this next-generation title, encouraging viewers to look beyond the cinematic hype to truly understand what the future of gaming will look like.

en-US.title: Those Who Leave
en-US.description:
“Jaanewale O Jaanewale” is a beautiful, emotional melody from Jaanwar, capturing the feelings of love, longing, and separation.

Featuring Akshay Kumar and Karisma Kapoor.

Movie: Jaanwar (1999)
Song: Jaanewale O Jaanewale
Starcast: Akshay Kumar, Karisma Kapoor.
Singer(s): Ram Shankar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik
Music: Anand Milind
Directed by - Suneel Darshan
Production & Worldwide Copyrights - Shree Krishna International, India.

Lyrics:
God is watching
The deserted roads are stopping me
O... my heartless traveler
Come and hold my arms
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving

Going, going
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving

An animal without pain is a monster
Only he who shares someone's grief is a human being
He who becomes a support for the helpless here
Only he is truly called a savior
From this piece of my heart
By turning away from this piece of my heart like this

O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
Oh those who are leaving
O those who are leaving
Oh those who are leaving

O... come...

For you, I gave up digging
You have shown me your loyalty Infidelity
A false oath, your promise was false
I trusted you, but you betrayed me
Tears will flow from my eyes
I will keep saying you are unfaithful
You left me heartless
You left me heartless, breaking the glass of my heart

O departing one, oh departing one
O departing one, oh departing one
O departing one, oh departing one
O departing one
O departing one

I am alone, abandoned
No one is my heir
Some devil will come
He will take me away
He will inflict torture on me
He will teach only hatred
Whoever has evil as their destination
He will show such a path
He will turn a human being
He will turn a beast
He will turn a beast
He will turn a beast
He will turn a beast

If you want this
No one should be ruined again
If you think this
Let there be no cries again
Bring the boat to the shore
Remove the thorns from the flowers
Show me the way
Make my life
Make my life
Make my life Give me my life

From ruin, from failure
From ruin, from failure
By breaking my relationship

O Jaane Wale O Jaane Wale
O Jaane Wale O Jaane Wale
O Jaane Wale O Jaane Wale
O Jaane Wale O Jaane Wale

snippet.title: இயேசையா உங்க சமூகம் | Yesaiah Unga Samugam | Joseph Aldrin | Tamil Christian New Song 2026
snippet.description:
This song was an answer to a question which I asked to myself in 2018 as I sat to worship .

Why do I long to worship and enjoy His presence. Why do I always want to come to Him and lean on His bosom by singing . 

And my heart answered it as a melody from Psalm 34:5 and Luke 10:38-42.

May God use this song and put a desire in many hearts to enjoy His bosom, & may He use this song to draw many to His intimate presence.


Written, Composed & Sung by JOSEPH ALDRIN
Music by JOHNPAUL REUBEN | Video by JUDAH ARUN 

Music Credits:
Music Produced & Arranged by Johnpaul Reuben @ Jes Productions
Rhythm Programming - Godwin
Flute - Aben Jotham  |  Veena - Shiva
Violin - Francis Xavier | Backing Vocals Harmony - Shobi Ashika 
Vocal Processing - Godwin 
Mix and Mastering - Jerome Alan Ebenezer @Joanna Studio
Flutes, Veena & Backing Vocals  Recorded @ Tapas Studios - Manoj
Vocals recorded @ Dreamscape Pro Studios - Samuel Graceson

Video Credits:
Camera & Drone: GIPSON SELLATHURAI, KEVIN FERNANDO 
Edit, Color Grading & Poster Design: JUDAH ARUN (+91- 97863 88181)

Special thanks to Pr. LARWIN NICKELSON, Oikos Tamil Church, Switzerland for all your hearty support and love.

Also grateful to Pr. JOHN KARUNA and Sis. LOUISAAL for all their love and support. Thank you WALTER uncle. My heartfelt thanks to GIPSON SELLATHURAI and KEVIN FERNANDO for all their labour of love as they shot the video tirelessly.

Thanks to Pr. JOSEPH BALACHANDRAN 


“I express my heartfelt gratitude
 to My Spiritual Father, Fr. S J BERCHMANS"



Lyrics

இதன் மகிழ்ச்சி, இதன் நிறைவு,
இதில் நீங்காத பேரின்பமே
இதன் மகிழ்ச்சி, இதன் நிறைவு,
இதில் நிரந்தர சமாதானமே

உம்மைப் பார்க்கப் பார்க்க பிரகாசம் அடைகின்றேன் – 2

வெட்கப்பட்டுப் போவதில்லை நான்,

snippet.title: Chhodh Ke Na Jaa Ooh Piya (Video) Alka Yagnik | Arbaaz Khan, Monal, Sunny Deol | Maa Tujhhe Salaam
snippet.description:
"Chhodh Ke Na Jaa Ooh Piya" is a soulful and emotional track from the movie Maa Tujhhe Salaam (2002), beautifully sung by Alka Yagnik. The song expresses a deep sense of love, longing, and heartache, as the singer pleads with her lover not to leave. With its heartfelt lyrics and Alka Yagnik’s powerful voice, this song stands out as one of the most poignant and memorable moments in the film.

Credits: 
Singer: Alka Yagnik
Music: Sajid-Wajid
Lyrics: Sameer
Movie: Maa Tujhhe Salaam
Starring: Sunny Deol, Tabu
Director: Tinu Verma
Producer: Mahendra Dhariwal
Label: Universal Music India

Lyrics:

ना चूड़ी खनकेगी ना पायल छनकेगी
 ना गजरा महकेगा ना काजल बहकेगा
 ना जा, ना जा
 छोड़ के ना जाओ पिया, छोड़ के ना जाओ पिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 प्यार मैंने तुझको है किया

 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 पिया ओ पिया, पिया ओ पिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
नींद भी तू, मेरा ख्वाब भी तू है
 बिना तेरे कैसे रहूं
 तौबा दुहाई ये दर्द-ए-जुदाई
 भला ऐसे कैसे सहूं
 मौसम है यादों का, कसमों का, वादों का
 आ करीब आ, साठिया... आ करीब आ, साठिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
 तुझको मैंने ये दिल दे दिया
पलके झुका लूं, नज़र में छुपा लूं
 कहीं दूर जाने न दूं
 तेरे मेरा बीच आए हवा तो
 उसे भी मैं आने न दूं
 बस इतना कहना है, सांसों में रहना है
 चैन मेरा तूने ले लिया, चैन मेरा तूने ले लिया

snippet.description:
Listen to this beautiful melody "Nadhiye Nadhiye" song from 'Rhythm' starring Arjun, Meena and Jyothika directed by Vasanth and music composed by A R Rahman

Song Credits:-
Nadhiyae Nadhiyae
Singer: Unni Menon
Music: A. R. Rahman
Lyrics: Vairamuthu


Lyrics

Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa
Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa
Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa Dhiranaa
Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa
Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa
Dheemthananaa Dheemthananaa Dhiranaa

Nadhiyae Nadhiyae Kaadhal Nadhiyae
Neeyum Pendhaanae
Adi Neeyum Pendhaanae
Onraa Irandaa Kaaranam Nooru
Kaettaal Solvaenae
Nee Kaettaal Solvaenae

(Dheemthananaa)

River, river, river of love
You are a woman too
You are a woman too
One or two, the reasons are a hundred
If asked I will tell
If you ask, I will tell

Nadandhaal Aaru
Ezhundhaal Aruvi
Ninraal Kadalalloa
Samaindhaal Kumari
Manandhaal Manaivi
Petraal Thaayalloa

Get tickets for your favorite artists

bye
Ariana Grande
don’t wanna break up again
Ariana Grande
we can’t be friends (wait for your love)
Ariana Grande

When walking, she's a river
When rising, a waterfall
When standing still, the ocean
When she grows, a young woman
When she weds, a wife
When she gives birth, a mother

Siru Nadhigalae
Nadhiyidum Karaigalae
Karaithodum Nuraigalae
Nuraigalil Ival Mugamae

Little rivers
The rivers' banks
The foam that touches the banks
Her face in the bubbles

Dhinam Moadhum Karai Thoarum
Ada Aarum Isai Paadum
Jil Jil Jil Enra Sruthiyilae
Gangai Varum Yamunai Varum
Vaigai Varum Porunai Varum
Jal Jal Jal Enra Nadaiyilae

The music of the brushing of a river
Along the lengths of it's banks all day
This happy, happy tone
The Ganga/Ganges will come, Yamuna will
Vaigai and Ponni too
With this rhythmic rhythmic walking


Kaadhali Arumai Pirivil
Manaiviyin Arumai Maraivil
Neerin Arumai Arivaay Koadaiyilae
Vetkam Vandhaal Uraiyum
Viralgal Thottaal Urugum
Neerum Pennum Onru Vaadaiyilae

A lover's wonder, on separation
A wife's importance, on death
Water's importance, you'll realise during summer
Colours will rise when she's shy
On contact, fingers will melt
Water and women share their scent

Thanneer Kudaththil Pirakkiroam Oho
Thanneer Karaiyil Mudikkiroam Oho
Thanneer Kudaththil Pirakkiroam Oho
Thanneer Karaiyil Mudikkiroam Oho

In a pot of water we are born (womb)
On the banks of water our existences finish (ashes)

(Dheemthananaa)

Vanna Vanna Pennae
Vattamidum Nadhiyae
Valaivugal Azhagu
Ungal Valaivugal Azhagu
Ho! Mellisaigal Padiththal
Maedu Pallam Maraiththal
Nadhigalin Gunamae
Adhu Nangaiyin Gunamae


Colourful woman
The meandering river
Curves are beautiful
Your curves are beautiful
Ho! The gentleness of the way your lay
And hide the rough contours of the land
Are the qualities of a river
Are the qualities of a woman

(Siru Nadhigalae)
(Dheemthananaa)

Thaenkaniyil Saaraagi
Pookkalilae Thaenaagi
Pasuvinilae Paalaagum Neerae
Thaayarugae Saeyaagi
Thalaivanidam Paayaagi
Saeyarugae Thaayaagum Pennae

Water; In a honey of a fruit, in the nectar in a flower
And in the milk in a gentle cow
Girl; The infant with her mother, the lover of her man
And the mother with an infant

Poonguyilae Poonguyilae
Pennum Aarum Vadivam Maarakkoodum
Neer Ninaiththaal
Pen Ninaiththaal
Karaigal* Yaavum Karaindhu Poagak Koodum

Dear singing bird
A woman and a river change forms
If the water wishes it
If a woman wishes it
Any bank* can be broken and dissolved
Any stain* can be washed clean

(Nadhiyae Nadhiyae)
(Dheemthananaa)


Label: Saregama India Limited, A RPSG Group Company
